title: Positive Ratings, Hidden Concerns: Employee Voice Disclosure in AI-Mediated Organizational Listening
abstract: arXiv:2609.38788v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Organizations started listening to employees through conversational AI agents alongside structured surveys. Little is known about what these channels change in what employees say when disclosure carries hierarchical risk. We report a field study inside a global management consulting firm whose process pairs a pre-survey with an adaptive AI voice interview on the same themes within one session. Across 44 first-session interviews (132 matched theme observations), 20-41% of sessions showed a favorable rating co-occurring with a substantive concern voiced later, depending on the favorability threshold. The Gioia analysis drew on 158 protective quotes from 65 eligible sessions. Disclosure rarely arrived unguarded: employees softened concerns, deflected accountability, and bounded how far they went, and this protective work tracked the perceived legitimacy of the listening structure. translated_title: 正面评分背后的隐忧：AI媒介化组织倾听中的员工心声披露
translated_abstract: 各类组织已开始借助对话式AI代理以及结构化问卷来倾听员工的声音。然而，当披露本身带有层级风险时，这些新渠道究竟会如何改变员工所表达的内容，目前仍知之甚少。我们报告了一项在全球某管理咨询公司内部开展的实地研究：该公司的流程是在同一场次中，先进行一次问卷预调查，随后就相同主题进行一次自适应的AI语音访谈。在44场首次访谈（132条匹配的主题观察）中，依据正面评分阈值的不同设定，有20%-41%的场次出现了正面评分与随后才说出的实质性顾虑并存的现象。Gioia扎根分析基于来自65个合格场次的158条防护性话语展开。员工几乎从不进行毫无防备的披露：他们会软化顾虑、转移责任归属，并限定自己披露的深度，而这种防护性行为与他们对倾听机制合法性的感知程度相关联。我们据此构建了一个关于“有界披露”的扎根理论模型，并推导出……
tldr: 该研究通过全球咨询公司的实地研究揭示，员工在AI语音访谈中常给出正面评分的同时对实质性顾虑进行软化、转移责任并限定披露深度，据此提出“有界披露”的扎根理论模型，表明员工的防护性披露行为取决于其对组织倾听机制合法性的感知。
en_tdlr: A field study in a global consulting firm reveals that employees often pair positive ratings with softened, accountability-deflecting, and depth-limited disclosure of substantive concerns in AI voice interviews, leading to a grounded model of "bounded disclosure" in which protective behavior tracks the perceived legitimacy of the listening structure.
